channel.title: amanu
channel.description: Updates for amanu, a local-first meeting recorder for macOS.

item.description:
amanu 0.6.5

  • Fixed Command-V in API-key fields on macOS, including the OpenAI-compatible summary provider.
  • Added the standard Edit menu with Cut, Copy, Paste, and Select All shortcuts for text fields.

Compatibility

  • Universal binary for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14.2 or later. Local transcription requires Apple Silicon; Intel requires a cloud transcription key and has not been tested on physical hardware.
